verdict.rationale: Phaser is a game framework, so profiling and data-oriented scaling paths are a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents no built-in profiler, ECS, job system, or instancing path. Community remarks about general rendering speed do not show that the product ships these capabilities.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can profile and scale — a real profiler, plus data-oriented paths (ECS, jobs, instancing) when scenes get heavy
